initial_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final website favicon and personal academic monogram for Fujiang Ji, an imaging spectroscopy and ecosystem researcher.
Primary request: design ONE beautifully balanced, original, extremely clear square favicon. A deep academic blue rounded-square tile with bold white uppercase FJ as the dominant symbol, plus a single small pale-teal leaf at the upper-right integrated delicately with the J terminal. The leaf subtly suggests ecology and remote sensing.
Text (verbatim): "FJ". Spell precisely F and J, no other text.
Style/medium: impeccably clean flat graphic logo, geometric sans-serif letterforms, crisp smooth edges, generous stroke width, restrained modern academic identity. FJ must remain immediately readable when the entire icon is scaled to 16 x 16 pixels.
Composition: straight-on icon, square canvas. Rounded-square tile almost fills the canvas, only 2% transparent margin. FJ fills about 70% of tile width and 65% of height; align the two letters optically, use open counters and clear separation. The leaf is secondary and simple, about 15% of tile width.
Color palette: tile solid #365F9C, FJ solid white, leaf pale teal #8DD9C4. Transparent outside the tile, fully opaque blue inside.
Constraints: one single final mark, centered, high contrast on both white and dark browser tab bars. Keep the design simple and compact. No words, no full name, no small lettering, no photography, no satellite drawings, no fine lines, no gradients, no shadow, no bevel, no 3D, no mockups, no presentation sheet, no multiple alternatives, no watermark.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Edit target: the attached FJ favicon.
Keep the exact white F and J letter shapes, the mint leaf shape, their positions, and the rounded-square tile silhouette.
Change only the surface finish and clean the alpha mask:
Fill ALL of the tile's blue region with one completely uniform flat opaque color #365F9C. Remove the entire dark smudge/artifact above the FJ near the upper center. Remove all gradients, lighting variation, paper texture, speckles, stains and shadows. White FJ must be solid #FFFFFF, leaf solid #8DD9C4.
The tile interior must be fully opaque, including the previously stained area. Preserve transparent corners/outside the rounded tile only. Remove stray colored pixels outside the tile. Do not insert any new marks.
Result must look like immaculate flat vector artwork with smooth crisp boundaries, ready to be used as a tiny browser favicon on both white and dark tab bars. One icon, no mockups, no other text.
notes: Original raster master retained for editing; favicon exports resized with macOS sips. Transparent outer corners preserved. Flat FJ monogram and leaf on an academic blue tile.
